baseline.note: beta 0 on every instrument: excluded, holds, confirmed

present.note: beta 1.2 per point (30 points over the span): present, falsified

attenuated.note: beta 0.35 per point (about 9 points): attenuated, partly missed

inconclusive.note: beta 0.35 per point with wide noise: the interval cannot tell zero from m_s (inconclusive)

two_step_within.note: form (a) excluded with form (b) present (bias-net lower bound above 0) on the carrier: the two-step conflict within an instrument

two_step_across.note: the carrier excluded, the second named instrument present: a two-step conflict across instruments

one_step_across.note: the carrier excluded, the second attenuated: differs by one step, beside

floor_carrier.note: the carrier's sham drawn from the quiet distribution: the carrier at floor (a) issues only its floor sentence (G3), the second leads as the fallback carrier

floor_both.note: both named instruments at floor: no verdict

floor_b.note: form (b)'s floor failed: the quiet lone recall does not clear the sham's

ceiling.note: quiet lone recall above 0.85: form (b) past the ceiling

fit_i_constant.note: fit failure (i): the writer constant on the subset; the reading steps down to the stratum

subset_stratum_disagree.note: the nine unresolved members carry a strong effect, the subset none: the subset and the stratum disagree (S-I2)

fit_ii_replicates.note: fit failure (ii): a factor level held by one item on the subset, so more than 10 percent of the 2,000 replicates are singular (property asserted)

fit_iii_empty_stratum.note: fit failure (iii): every item of one pooled stratum of the subset refused under the carrier (an empty pooled stratum; the loss is above 10 percent)

stratum_too.note: the writer constant on the whole stratum: the carrier unfit on 17 and 26, the second takes the lead (S-C3), is unfit too, the third branch (S-H1)

third_present.note: as above with a full-set present: S-H2

nothing_fits.note: the writer and the replace share constant on the full set: nothing fits on any population (S-C3b, S-C4)

c5_form_b_singular.note: the judge's singleton maximum constant: form (b)'s design singular (S-C5)

c6_other_unfit.note: the second named instrument loses a pooled stratum of the subset to refusals: unfit there while the carrier reads (S-C6)

refused_component.note: one lone-line application refused under the carrier: that item not evaluable (n = 16 on the subset)

stopped_lead.note: the carrier's row not scored at a stop: treated as not passing its floor; the second leads

stopped_second.note: the second named instrument's row not scored at a stop: it drops out, named

g1_fails.note: Opus 4.8's composed share below 0.65: G1 fails

sq1.note: flags driven by the rater's section-2 maximum: S-Q1

k1.note: the composition contrast falls with Kimi K3's D_part: S-K1

k2.note: the composition contrast rises with D_part: S-K2

g6_clean.note: G6: three subset items and one more stratum item touched by a broken honest edit; form (a) on the rest, beside, descriptive

g6_too_small.note: G6: fifteen of the subset's seventeen touched: the restricted sets too small for the fit (the subset singular, the stratum with an empty pooled stratum); the sentence says so with the counts

unreachable.S-P1: unreachable by decision: the k = 2 arm is not run (plan section 4.6, S2's note)
unreachable.S4-1: written by a separate $0 session after Aravind reports his scores (brief 33 B3)
unreachable.S-Fscope: a clause attached to S-F1 (reached with it)

oc.seeding: one stream per experiment: default_rng([20261171, 500, truth index, model index, experiment index])
